description: This file defines the ContentViewModel class, which manages the state and logic for a SwiftUI view related to an agent interaction workflow. It handles user input, agent steps, running state, and communicates with an AgentService to perform tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: ContentViewModel
classes.description: A view model class conforming to ObservableObject that manages user input, agent steps, and UI state for a SwiftUI view.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Initiates the agent process with the current user input after validating it.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Clears the agent steps, resets error messages, and clears user input.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate SF Symbol icon name based on the step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a specific step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Provides a descriptive title string for a given step type.
